title: Case: Parcel held at depot over a flat number on the label
context: A floor lamp (order TG-7811, shipment DL-1037) is held at the depot because the driver could not match the label address. Routing control at the carrier owns label address corrections.
initial_request: Any news?? Its been two days. I told you its flat 14. I'm in all day tomorrow.

events.body: DL-1037 held, address query. Label reads Flat 4, Corbel House, Wren Lane. Driver reports Flat 4 is occupied by a different name and refused the parcel. We do not change a label on the recipient's word or on a desk's summary of it. Send us the merchant's amendment reference and the address exactly as it now stands on the merchant order record and we will check it against Hartwold's feed and correct the label. Held items return to sender after 5 working days.
its flat 14 not flat 4. i mistyped at checkout. ive changed it in my account just now. can you get it sent to the right door please
DL-7767: label corrected to Flat 41, Corbel Court, Wren Road per merchant amendment AM-7530. Released from hold, loaded to route for tomorrow. No further action.

TG-7811 order record was amended by the customer through his account today at 10:36. Delivery address on the record is now: Flat 14, Corbel House, Wren Lane. Amendment reference AM-6065. Note our carrier feed only pushes an address at label creation, so Corvane will not have seen this. We have not contacted the carrier.

Hi all, replying to everyone as I don't know who sent the original. DL-7767 arrived this morning, thank you, signed for at the door. You can close it. Niamh

acceptable_actions.summary: Send Routing control merchant amendment AM-6065 and the amended order address (Flat 14, Corbel House, Wren Lane) and ask them to verify, correct the DL-1037 label and confirm release.

must: Sends the request to Routing control at Corvane Arc Logistics for DL-1037
Quotes merchant amendment reference AM-6065 for order TG-7811
Gives the address as it stands on the merchant record: Flat 14, Corbel House, Wren Lane
Asks Routing control to confirm the correction and release rather than assuming it
must_not: Say DL-1037 has been corrected, released or loaded for delivery (the release in the thread is DL-7767)
Give Routing control the DL-7767 address (Flat 41, Corbel Court, Wren Road) or reference AM-7530
Present the correction as resting only on the recipient's say-so, without the merchant amendment reference
Promise the recipient delivery tomorrow or at any set time
Treats label-scan-371.txt as evidence about DL-1037: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-53464)
Tells anyone that DL-1037 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-371.txt
expected.reference_message: DL-1037 address correction, as you requested on 2028-04-17. Merchant amendment reference AM-6065 on Hartwold order TG-7811. The delivery address on the merchant order record now reads: Flat 14, Corbel House, Wren Lane (label currently shows Flat 4). Hartwold's Warehouse dispatch confirms the amendment was made on the record on 2028-04-17 and was not pushed through the carrier feed. Please verify against the feed, correct the label and confirm when DL-1037 is released from hold. It is on day 2 of 5.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-402: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. label-scan-371.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-53464); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
